variablesInModel.Name: event time
variablesInModel.Description: Time of event i in E in minutes, within the horizon [0, D]; R+ by (33). Written v_j or v_i in the constraints.

variablesInModel.Name: event order
variablesInModel.Description: 0 if event i takes place chronologically before event j, 1 otherwise, for every activity (i,j) in A; binary by (35).

variablesInModel.Name: cancellation of a shunting movement
variablesInModel.Description: 1 if shunting movement n in N^S is canceled, 0 otherwise; binary by (36), declared for all n in N and fixed to 0 for passenger trains n in N^T by (32).

variablesInModel.Name: event-time deviation
variablesInModel.Description: Deviation of event time v_j from its original time pi_j, in minutes; free, d_j in R by (34).

variablesInModel.Name: absolute deviation
variablesInModel.Description: Absolute value of the deviation of event j from the original timetable, modeled by (30)-(31); R+ by (33).

objective_functions.Name: (22) weighted deviation and cancellation cost
objective_functions.equation: \min \sum_{j \in E} w_j^{\text{deviation}} a_j + \sum_{n \in N^S} w_n^{\text{cancel}} X_n
objective_functions.description: Minimize the weighted absolute deviations of event times from the original timetable plus the weighted cancellations of shunting movements; the weights are parameters.

constraints.Name: (23) event time window
constraints.equation: 0 \le v_j \le D(1 - X_n) \quad \forall n \in N, \forall j \in E_n
constraints.description: Event times lie in [0, D]; events of a canceled shunting movement get v_j = 0. One numbered equation with two inequalities, kept as one constraint; D X_n is linear.

constraints.Name: (24) driving and dwelling durations
constraints.equation: l_{i,j}(1 - X_n) \le v_j - v_i \le u_{i,j}(1 - X_n) \quad \forall n \in N, \forall (i,j) \in A_{\text{drive}}^n \cup A_{\text{dwell}}^n
constraints.description: Driving and dwelling activities respect their lower and upper bounds unless the movement is canceled; l_{i,j} and u_{i,j} are parameters (this u is not a variable).

constraints.Name: (25) shunting (un)couple times
constraints.equation: l_{i,j}(1 - X_m - X_n) \le v_j - v_i + q_{i,j} D \le u_{i,j}(1 - X_m - X_n) + D(X_m + X_n) \quad \forall (i,j) \in A_{\text{shunt}}, i \in E_m, j \in E_n, m,n \in N
constraints.description: Minimum and maximum (un)couple times between a composition's arrival/departure and its shunting movements. Printed over two lines, one constraint; X_m, X_n are family X; q D is linear.

constraints.Name: (26) headway on infrastructure points
constraints.equation: h_{i,j}(1 - X_m - X_n) \le v_j - v_i + q_{i,j} D \le (D - h_{i,j})(1 - X_m - X_n) + D(X_m + X_n) \quad \forall p \in P, (i,j) \in A_{\text{headway}}^p, \ldots
constraints.description: Minimum headway between trains/shunting movements m, n on the same track or crossing p, in either order via q_{i,j}. Printed over two lines, one constraint; X_m, X_n are family X.

constraints.Name: (27) deviation definition
constraints.equation: d_j = v_j - \pi_j(1 - X_n) \quad \forall n \in N, \forall j \in E_n
constraints.description: Deviation of each event time from its original time pi_j (a parameter); the original time drops out for a canceled movement.

constraints.Name: (28) deviation bound for passenger trains
constraints.equation: 0 \le d_j \le d_{\max}^{+} \quad \forall n \in N^T, \forall j \in E_n
constraints.description: Passenger-train events may be delayed by at most d_max^+, not advanced. Kept as a constraint, not a domain declaration: a bound by the model parameter d_max^+ on a subset; d_j's domain is (34).

constraints.Name: (29) deviation bound for shunting movements
constraints.equation: -d_{\max}^{+} \le d_j \le d_{\max}^{+} \quad \forall n \in N^S, \forall j \in E_n
constraints.description: Shunting-movement events may deviate by at most d_max^+ in either direction. Kept as a constraint for the same reason as (28).

constraints.Name: (30) absolute deviation, positive part
constraints.description: With (31), a_j is at least |d_j| (linearized absolute value).

constraints.Name: (31) absolute deviation, negative part
constraints.description: With (30), a_j is at least |d_j| (linearized absolute value).

constraints.Name: (32) no cancellation of passenger trains
constraints.description: Passenger trains cannot be canceled. Kept as a constraint: a fixing on the subset N^T that the paper numbers with its constraints, while (33)-(36) are the domains.
